run_process_command: run a child process with a command list and optional time and memory limits
get_child_process_cpu_time: get the total CPU time in seconds used by child processes of this process
run_process_with_time_limit: run a process with a 10 second time limit and return stdout, return code, and CPU time
run_process_with_memory_limit: run a process with a 1048576 byte memory limit and capture its output
run_process_no_limits: run a subprocess command without time or memory limits and retrieve its stdout
